topics.title: Objectives of Asset Liability Management
topics.objective: The candidate will understand the objectives of Asset Liability Management (ALM).

outcomes.text: Explain the principles of Asset Liability Management
Understand the lessons learned from ALM failures
Demonstrate an understanding of various ALM risks
Describe how different pension and insurance contracts generate embedded options

topics.title: Measuring Risks from Assets and Liabilities
topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to measure risks from assets and liabilities.

outcomes.text: Demonstrate an understanding of various risk identification tools
Evaluate a company’s or a portfolio’s exposures to various risks
Understand measures of regulatory capital adequacy for life insurance companies in various jurisdictions
Evaluate the difficulties of investing for long-tail liabilities (i.e. beyond 30 years) such as inflation and longevity

topics.title: Tools and Strategies to Manage ALM Risks
topics.objective: The candidate will understand tools and strategies to manage ALM risks.

outcomes.text: Develop and critique asset allocation strategies appropriate to underlying liability profiles such as pension plans and long-tail insurance liabilities
Demonstrate an understanding of and apply tools and techniques for measuring and managing interest rate risk in an ALM context
Apply stress testing and scenario analysis to assess extreme ALM events
Understand and evaluate model and parameter risks
Explain and implement techniques used to mitigate market risks
Understand interest rate derivatives and use them to mitigate interest rate risk
Explain different methods available for transferring risk
